<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use MongoDB\Client;

class ProductSearchController extends Controller
{
    private $mongoClient;
    private $collection;

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->mongoClient = new Client(env('MONGODB_URI', 'mongodb://localhost:27017'));
        $this->collection = $this->mongoClient->selectDatabase('ecommerce')->selectCollection('products');
    }

    /**
     * Search products with filters
     * Supports: name, category, price range, tags
     */
    public function search(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'name' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'category' => 'nullable|string|max:100',
            'min_price' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'max_price' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'tags' => 'nullable|string|max:500',
        ]);

        $filter = ['active' => true];

        if (!empty($validated['name'])) {
            // Text search with regex for partial matching
            $filter['name'] = ['$regex' => $validated['name'], '$options' => 'i'];
        }

        if (!empty($validated['category'])) {
            $filter['category'] = $validated['category'];
        }

        if (!empty($validated['min_price']) || !empty($validated['max_price'])) {
            $filter['price'] = [];
            if (!empty($validated['min_price'])) {
                $filter['price']['$gte'] = (float) $validated['min_price'];
            }
            if (!empty($validated['max_price'])) {
                $filter['price']['$lte'] = (float) $validated['max_price'];
            }
        }

        // Advanced filter: parse JSON filter from query param for power users
        if ($request->has('advanced_filter')) {
            $advancedFilter = json_decode($request->input('advanced_filter'), true);
            if (is_array($advancedFilter)) {
                $filter = array_merge($filter, $advancedFilter);
            }
        }

        // Sort configuration
        $sortField = $request->input('sort_by', 'created_at');
        $sortDir = $request->input('sort_dir', 'desc') === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;

        $options = [
            'sort' => [$sortField => $sortDir],
            'limit' => min((int) $request->input('limit', 20), 100),
            'skip' => max((int) $request->input('offset', 0), 0),
            'projection' => [
                'name' => 1,
                'category' => 1,
                'price' => 1,
                'description' => 1,
                'tags' => 1,
                'image_url' => 1,
                'rating' => 1,
            ]
        ];

        try {
            $cursor = $this->collection->find($filter, $options);
            $products = iterator_to_array($cursor);

            // Sanitize ObjectId for JSON response
            $results = array_map(function ($product) {
                $product['id'] = (string) $product['_id'];
                unset($product['_id']);
                return $product;
            }, $products);

            $total = $this->collection->countDocuments($filter);

            return response()->json([
                'data' => $results,
                'meta' => [
                    'total' => $total,
                    'limit' => $options['limit'],
                    'offset' => $options['skip'],
                ]
            ]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            report($e);
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Search failed'], 500);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Get product details by slug
     */
    public function show(string $slug)
    {
        $product = $this->collection->findOne([
            'slug' => $slug,
            'active' => true
        ]);

        if (!$product) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Product not found'], 404);
        }

        $product['id'] = (string) $product['_id'];
        unset($product['_id']);

        return response()->json(['data' => $product]);
    }
}
